title: Why Steelers leaving 'door open' for Aaron Rodgers return may mean less than you think

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Why Steelers leaving 'door open' for Aaron Rodgers return may mean less than you think
sources.description: If the 42-year-old doesn't return for another season, Pittsburgh's options at QB are limited. The Steelers can't afford to wait around for a decision like last year.
